title: py.test can't multiple parametrize with ids if it parametrizes class with two or more test methods

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

body:
Originally reported by: **sergey chipiga (BitBucket: [schipiga](http://bitbucket.org/schipiga), GitHub: [schipiga](http://github.com/schipiga))**

---

Code example

``` python
import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize('x', [0], ids=['c'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('y', [0, 1], ids=['a', 'b'])
class Test(object):

    def test1(self, x, y):
        pass

    def test2(self, x, y):
        pass
```
